summary: A long-form modern German tasting-menu dinner by twin chefs Mathias and Thomas Sühring, served in a restored 1970s villa in Yen Akat. Michelin's 2026 listing describes seasonal cooking rooted in German techniques and family memories; expect a polished, special-occasion meal rather than a quick or inexpensive stop.
whyGo: For a distinctive European tasting menu in Bangkok, built around German traditions such as fermentation, pickling and curing.
The restored villa, garden setting and kitchen-counter seats add atmosphere to a multi-course meal.
A strong choice for a celebratory dinner if you are comfortable committing several hours and a substantial budget.
bestFor: Special occasions, tasting-menu enthusiasts and diners curious about contemporary German cuisine.
Couples or small groups who enjoy a leisurely, structured meal.
skipIf: You want casual Thai food, à la carte flexibility, a short meal or a modest bill.
You have strict dietary needs that have not been discussed with the restaurant in advance.
duration: Allow roughly 2.5–3.5 hours as a planning estimate for a full tasting menu; confirm the expected pace when booking.
cost: High-end. Michelin lists the restaurant in its top price band (฿฿฿฿); a third-party 2026 guide reports tasting menus around ฿7,800–฿9,800 before any pairing or extras. Treat that range as indicative and verify the current menu, taxes and service charge directly before booking.
hours: The restaurant currently lists lunch Thursday–Sunday, last seating 12:30–13:00, and dinner Wednesday–Sunday, last seating 17:30–19:30; closed Monday and Tuesday. Holiday service may differ.
bestTime: Book a dinner seating for an occasion; lunch is an option Thursday–Sunday if you prefer a daytime meal. Choose a seating time that leaves room for an unhurried experience and traffic on the way back.
gettingThere: At No. 10 Yen Akat Soi 3, Chong Nonsi, Yannawa. A taxi or ride-hail to the door is the simplest plan for most visitors; allow extra travel time in evening traffic. The restaurant lists car parking and valet parking. Confirm the pickup point with your driver because the lane is residential.
booking: Reserve through the restaurant's official booking link. It accepts reservations up to 60 days ahead and recommends booking about a month ahead; join the waitlist if your date is unavailable. For groups larger than eight, contact the restaurant by phone or email.
accessibility: The venue is a villa. Published details do not establish step-free access, accessible toilets, or seating accommodations; contact the restaurant before booking if these are needed. Michelin lists car park and valet parking.
practicalTips: Check the live menu and price directly before committing; the menu changes seasonally and online prices may lag.
Share allergies, dietary restrictions and celebration requests when booking, then reconfirm them with the team.
Ask about wine or non-alcoholic pairings and the final total, including service and tax.
Plan door-to-door transport rather than relying on a short walk from transit; the restaurant is in Yen Akat Soi 3.
decemberNotes: December 2026 reservations are within the restaurant's stated 60-day booking window from October 17 only for dates up to mid-December; later dates should open closer to the visit. Confirm holiday opening days and any special menus directly, as no December 2026 schedule was published in the sources checked. Bangkok evenings can be busy, so allow a traffic buffer.
uncertainties: December 2026 holiday hours, special menus and remaining reservation availability are not yet confirmed.
The current price range comes from a third-party guide, not an official published price list; final charges may differ.
Step-free access, accessible facilities and detailed dietary accommodation are not stated in the sources reviewed.
